seo.title: Partner program for agencies | Steps AI
seo.description: Agencies can offer AI agents to their clients with Steps AI. Unlimited agents on paid plans, one account and one bill, and commission on every client you bring.

hero.title: Offer AI agents to your clients without building them.
hero.body: Your clients are asking for AI. Steps AI gives your agency the agents, channels and integrations to deliver it, under one account you manage.
hero.reassurance: Unlimited agents on paid plans. One account, one bill. Commission on clients you bring.

sections.title: Why agencies partner with Steps AI.
paragraphs: Most agencies do not have AI infrastructure of their own. Steps AI becomes the platform you set up, run and charge for.

items.title: One agent per client
items.body: Paid plans include unlimited agents, so each client gets their own agent, knowledge and channels.

items.title: Reporting per agent
items.body: Account-level analytics show conversations, response times and tickets for each agent, ready for client reports.

items.title: Commission on every client
items.body: Earn commission on the clients you bring to Steps AI. We share the full terms when you apply.

sections.title: Who it is for.
paragraphs: Digital, marketing and ecommerce agencies that build websites, run social channels or manage Shopify stores for their clients.
If you would rather send us customers than run agents yourself, see the affiliate program.

cta.title: Apply to become a partner.
cta.body: Book a call and we will walk through how the program works for your agency.
